QuestInfo.name: Cranky
QuestInfo.0: Find Blackbull in Perion. But be aware of his... eccentric personality.
QuestInfo.1: Blackbull pressured you into doing him a favor. Great. Go to #m102030000# by following the arrow signs, eliminate 100 Wild Boars, and obtain 50 Wild Boar Teeth.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the requested materials to Blackbull.

0.0: I haven't seen you before.\r\nI'm #bBlackbull.\r\nI think it's an act of providence that we met. Won't you do me a favor?

yes.0: Good choice. Go to #m102030000#, eliminate 50 Wild Boars and Terrified Wild Boars each, and bring me 50 Wild Boar Teeth. Gonna make me a nice necklace out of those chompers.

no.0: Lemme put it to you like this. I want Wild Boar Teeth for my necklace. If I don't get them, whose teeth do you THINK I'm going to use?

1.0: Where are my Wild Boar Teeth?

yes.0: Great. Lemme just arrange these so they symbolize my wisdom and kindness, or some junk. Hm...it's missing something. Hey, you got a gold tooth in that mouth of yours?
yes.1: Oh, relax. You may leave. \r\nIt seems #b10 Boogies#k has been up to some suspicious activity recently... Why don't you pay a visit?

item.0: I told you 50 Wild Boar Teeth, right? Well, I don't see 50 Wild Boar Teeth yet. You don't wanna make me mad, do you?
